capabilities: : Color file rows by Git status
: Color folder rows by descendant changes
extras: Desktop-only, read-only, single-repo scope for v1, no mobile support.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin for AI second-brain users that colors the File Explorer by Git status
problem: Users need a quick visual way to see Git status changes within the Obsidian File Explorer without switching to a full IDE.
summary: Colors the File Explorer rows based on Git status (new, modified, deleted) to help users quickly identify changes in their vault.
